name: The Art of AI
blurb: Ten creative disciplines and what artificial intelligence is doing inside each: how the work is made, what it runs on, who owns the result, and what is coming next.
title: The Art of AI
answer: Ten creative disciplines and what artificial intelligence is doing inside each: how the work is made, what it runs on, who owns the result, and what is coming next.

children.name: Visual Arts and Generative Illustration
children.blurb: Prompt architecture, concept art, vector assets, inpainting and colour: the still image made with diffusion models.

children.name: Cinematography and Video Synthesis
children.blurb: Text to video, virtual lensing, digital doubles, storyboarding and frame interpolation.

children.name: Vocal Synthesis and Operatic Performance
children.blurb: Voice cloning, lip sync, emotional delivery, choral layering and live voice conversion.

children.name: Music Composition and Audio Engineering
children.blurb: Score generation, stem separation, drum programming, mixing and mastering, and generated foley.

children.name: Choreography and Motion Mapping
children.blurb: Kinematic generation, notation, motion capture retargeting, crowd simulation and biomechanics.

children.name: Literary Arts and Narrative Design
children.blurb: Agentic drafting, outlining, character dialogue, continuity tracking and developmental editing.

children.name: Theater and Virtual Set Design
children.blurb: Stage renderings, projection mapping, lighting plots, costume synthesis and acoustic modelling.

children.name: Photography and Hyper-Realism
children.blurb: Synthetic portraiture, lighting rigs, upscaling, product mockups and virtual location scouting.

children.name: Interactive and Experiential Art
children.blurb: Audience-reactive installations, generative AR and VR, dialogue engines, data sculptures and audio-visual systems.

children.name: Rights and Provenance in AI Art
children.blurb: Copyright and trademark, licensing, training data and opt-outs, studio security, and content credentials.
